'''ST-789''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] who was part of the ambush squad for [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] during their quest to retrieve the moss painting ''[[Killik Twilight]]''.<ref name="TG" />
